note.zh: 末松谦澄所译前十七帖（1882），收入《日本文学》选集（1900）

note.en: The original Japanese, Kokubun Taikan edition

review.en: Fifty-four chapters following a shining prince, his loves and his decline, then the dimmer lives of those who come after him. Murasaki writes about rank, longing and the way time empties rooms, with a patience for inner life that prose fiction elsewhere would not reach for centuries. The last chapters, set in Uji, are colder and perhaps finer still.
review.zh: 五十四帖，先写光源氏的风华、爱恋与衰落，再写他身后那些更黯淡的人生。紫式部写身份、思慕，以及时间如何让房间一点点变空；她对内心的耐心，别处的散文小说要过好几百年才达到。最后的宇治十帖更清冷，也许更好。
